$comment: What each column of each Martinec et al. (2018) data file holds, decoded from the GMT 4 scripts that drew the published figures. Generated by scripts/decode_gmt_layouts.py. For files with no header these scripts are the only surviving record, and GMT 4 no longer runs. `negated` means the script plots the negative of the column, which is how several contributors' geoid sign is reconciled. `scale` records arithmetic applied before plotting.

vega_seven_column_format.$comment: The seven-column format VEGA writes, taken verbatim from the header of martinec2018/benchmarkA-Z_ZM_load-full.out, which is the only file in either archive that carries one. Twenty files use this format and none of the others documents it: both Z_ZM_*.out files, and the Z_*_diff.out files of benchmark B for GA, GS, KS, SK, VB, VK and YS. The benchmark A difference files and the two WW files of benchmark B hold four or five columns, which are a subset in the same order.

columns.name: abscissa
columns.description: Longitude in a figY_uvf cross-section, colatitude in a figZ_uvf one

columns.name: V_phi
columns.description: Longitude component of horizontal displacement. NaN at colatitude 0 and 180, where it is undefined.

columns.name: potential
columns.description: Gravitational potential increment. Divide by the surface gravity 9.8155 to obtain geoid height N, which is what the plotting scripts do.

columns.name: S
columns.description: Sea-surface variation with respect to the uniform water layer h_UF
